UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Cutline Studio user record stored cleanly under users/{userId}.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of user profile creation.

SocialConnection.title: SocialConnection
SocialConnection.description: Per-user connected social media OAuth provider credentials and profile metadata.

platform.description: Normalized provider identifier matching the document ID.

externalAccountId.description: Provider account ID (open_id, ig_user_id, or YouTube channel ID).

accessToken.description: OAuth bearer access token for publishing.

refreshToken.description: OAuth refresh token or empty string if provider issues long-lived tokens.

expiresAt.description: Access token expiration timestamp in Unix milliseconds (0 if non-expiring).

scopes.description: Granted OAuth permission scopes (bounded list of strings).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of connection write or token refresh.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user root profile document containing verified identity metadata.

/users/{userId}/socialConnections/{platf.description: Owner-only connected social accounts and OAuth tokens keyed by platform (tiktok, instagram, youtube).
